target.purpose: Detect exact train/eval contamination over supplied example identities and feature signatures under an explicit, receipt-bound policy.
target.central_bottleneck: Evaluation confidence collapses when training and evaluation sets silently overlap and the observed overlap cannot be tied back to the exact dataset identity and threshold policy used for the decision.
success: Exact example-ID and exact feature-hash overlap are measured separately.
Feature overlap ratio is explicit and reproducible.
Dataset and policy fingerprints are bound into every report fingerprint.
Malformed/duplicate identities and invalid thresholds fail closed.
Python and Go preserve the same contamination decision semantics.
The public claim never upgrades raw feature-hash equality into unproven semantic near-duplicate detection.

invariants: non-empty unique example identity within each dataset
exact ID overlap is counted separately from feature overlap
feature overlap ratio uses unique evaluation feature signatures
dataset identity and policy are included in the report receipt

donor_plan.basis: This repository owns exact train/eval contamination evidence; Scale-lens siblings own collusion and annotation-budget concerns.

nonclaims: not a production Scale AI evaluation service
no semantic near-duplicate computation from raw feature hashes
no model evaluation or benchmark execution
no exercised integration with collusion or annotation-budget siblings
